name: I-Chiun Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: I-Chiun Precision Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and trades machinery and parts, electronic components, electrical components, semiconductor LED lead frames, precision molds, and ceramic circuit boards in Taiwan, China, and internationally. The company offers optoelectronic products, including SMD top and side view, photo coupler, IC leadframe, and power module; and industrial computer case products and components, and precision component products. It also provides head spreader products; TV backlight units; ceramic substrate; and IC lead frame products.
